description: Generate a webhook request with a valid signature for Stripe, GitHub, or Slack. If targetUrl is provided, the request is POSTed there and the response is returned.

data.description: Optional fields to deep-merge into the fixture.

secret.description: Signing secret. Falls back to a deterministic default per provider.

targetUrl.description: If set, POST the generated request to this URL and return the response.
